**Finding: compliant** (rule RENEWAL, § 11.1, paragraph p0096).

Section 11.1 auto-renews for successive **one-year** terms and lets **either party** — including us — stop renewal on **30 days'** written notice. That meets the preferred position on both material terms (12-month renewal term, customer opt-out at 30 days), and is nowhere near the walk-away triggers: the five-year period is the negotiated initial term, not an automatic multi-year renewal.

Noted but not redlined (minor sub-elements per playbook classification):
- No Commerce One reminder 60 days before renewal.
- No cap on renewal price increases; Exhibit B pricing is redacted and contains no uplift mechanic.

These can be raised as drafting asks if the pricing figures are unblanked, but they do not warrant a redline. No proposal submitted.
